QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_15

question.text: A Cat III AIF pays the following annual fees to service providers (GST @ 18% applies to each): management fee INR 1 crore, trusteeship INR 25 lakh, fund admin INR 30 lakh, custodian INR 35 lakh. What is the TOTAL GST payable by the fund in the year?

explanation.text: The Logic: Total fees = 100 + 25 + 30 + 35 = INR 190 lakh. GST @ 18% on 190 lakh = INR 34.20 lakh. Cat III AIFs generally cannot offset this GST against output GST (AIFs don't render taxable output services to LPs) → fund-level GST is a real cost drag. The Trap: INR 18 lakh applies 18% to just management fee. INR 190 lakh is the fee base, not GST. INR 41.40 lakh double-counts. Cross-Exam Context: Ch. 14 (Taxation) tests GST at regulatory level; XIX-E Ch. 7 tests GST's fee-structure impact. Manager's Pro-Tip: GST on fund fees can run ~0.4–0.8% of GNAV annually — material drag. In the IM, disclose GST separately from management fee so investors see the full cost of ownership.
